prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one new original portrait illustration of Jackie Leven around 2000 for a series of restrained dark dry-brush ink portraits. THE RAISED DRINKING GLASS IS AN ESSENTIAL PART OF THE IMAGE.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the ORIGINAL photographic reference of Jackie raising a glass. It determines the actual facial likeness, age, distinctive tousled short-to-medium curly hair, watchful expression and raised-glass gesture. Discard the magazine text, colour background and exact photographic layout.
Image 2 is an approved 1994–95 illustration and image 3 is an approved later illustration. They are ONLY references for the series' drawing language, muted neutral-grey palette, low-key contrast and edges dissolving into darkness. Do not use their face proportions, ages, hairstyle, hand-under-chin pose or guitar.

SUBJECT AND LIKENESS:
The Jackie of photo 1, about fifty. Keep his individual strong brows, slightly hooded eyes, substantial nose, mouth shape, fuller cheeks, chin and natural asymmetry. Direct, steady, knowing gaze; reserved expression with a very subtle softness at the mouth, not a grin. Clean-shaven; no beard or invented moustache. The characteristic unruly shorter curls and lifted hair from photo 1, not the longer wavy hairstyle from illustration 2 or later haircut from illustration 3. Translate the lighter hair tips into restrained grey marks without adding colour. Do not make him younger, slim his face, idealize him or turn him into a generic rock star.

NEW COMPOSITION WITH GLASS:
Vertical 4:5 half-length / upper torso portrait, whole head with dark breathing room above, both shoulders suggested. New pose: head almost upright rather than the strongly tilted photo, torso in a slight three-quarter turn with the face looking toward the viewer.
He raises a clear, straight-sided, heavy-bottomed tumbler in his RIGHT HAND on the VIEWER'S LEFT, as a quiet personal toast. The complete glass, complete gripping hand and enough wrist/forearm must be visible, comfortably within the frame. Hold it just beside and below the face, the rim around lower-cheek to chin height, with a little dark space separating it from the face. It must not cover an eye, nose or mouth. Move it closer to his body than in the strongly foreshortened photograph: normal plausible glass and hand scale, no oversized foreground hand. The forearm forms a natural diagonal up from the lower left.
The glass is integral and unmistakably readable: a simple open elliptical rim, two broken side contours, a modest thick base, a few abbreviated cut-glass marks and a small amount of liquid in its lower part. Render the glass and liquid ONLY in neutral grey. No amber, gold or brown. Let transparency read through negative dark spaces and a few matte-grey edges, not highly detailed photorealistic reflections. The hand naturally wraps the lower half, anatomically coherent thumb and four fingers with correct overlapping and wrist connection. Only one visible hand, no jewellery or branding.
Dark jacket or overshirt and an open collar as in the source, drawn with sparse loose marks. The shirt is muted dark-grey rather than a large bright-white patch. Lower torso and forearm edges gradually dissolve into dry brush traces and then untouched darkness. No table, chair, bottle, guitar or background scenery.

STYLE:
Same visual family as the approved illustrations: rough hand-made dry-brush ink, a limited number of broad matte-grey light and shadow shapes, economical directional hatching and irregular broken edges. The face is unmistakably Jackie through accurate anatomy but simplified rendering. Hair in loose gestural clumps, clothes mostly negative space, hand and glass drawn as economically as the face. No photorealistic skin pores, hair-by-hair detailing, detailed hand veins or nails, glossy advertising-glass realism, smooth airbrush gradients, mechanical vector posterization or uniformly embossed digital texture. The drawing should remain legible at website size without becoming a polished photograph.

PALETTE AND MOOD:
Near-black anthracite #0d0f12 background, strictly neutral charcoal and muted neutral-grey values. No sepia, brown, beige, cream, blue or other colour cast. Match the subdued watermark-like tonal presence of images 2 and 3, with facial highlights approximately #62696d to #7a8083, tiny accents around #888c8f, no white glare. Glass highlights remain few, soft and no brighter than the face. Natural positive light/shadow, no photographic negative. Quiet, personal and self-possessed. Not a commercial drinks advertisement or party scene.
All outside edges dissolve into flat anthracite with no frame, paper border or visible rectangular boundary. No text, quotes, lettering, logos, signatures or other people. One standalone illustration.
